name: Kanto Gear
description: Companion UI for Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Silver, Crystal, Ruby, Sapphire, FireRed, LeafGreen and Emerald, with live maps, battle controls, route progress, notes, Day-Care and Calendar apps. Requires Recomp 0.3.20 or newer; Emerald requires 0.3.33 and Ruby/Sapphire 0.3.74 or newer.
